message.jaymospowers.karma.lighter: Something in you sits easier than it did.
message.jaymospowers.karma.heavier: Something far below has taken note of you.
message.jaymospowers.mortality.wake.belo: You wake on hot stone, and everything down here knows it. Somewhere a cold draught is blowing. Die here and it's over.
message.jaymospowers.karma.draught: A cold draught reaches you from the %s.
message.jaymospowers.karma.draught_near: The cold draught is close now.
message.jaymospowers.karma.out: The heat lets go of you. This life is yours again.
message.jaymospowers.karma.just_wake: You were weighed and let in. The fortune teller won't take coin from you. Win the tournament of the dead and you go back as you were.
message.jaymospowers.karma.lent: A blade was leaning by the hall door. Nobody stopped you taking it.
message.jaymospowers.karma.let_go: The Other World lets go of you before you've won. That life is over.
message.jaymospowers.karma.teller_no_coi: %s: "Not from you. You were weighed, and coin doesn't move that. Win in the ring."
talk.jaymospowers.teller.weighed: "I can't take coin from you. You were weighed, and coin doesn't move that. Ring the bell, win, and I'll send you back as you were."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.weigh_1: "Heavy. I'd need both hands to turn it. There's a place for pages like this, and it isn't here."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.weigh_2: "It leans the wrong way. Not far, yet."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.weigh_3: "Even. Most are. Even gets you born again and nothing more."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.weigh_4: "It leans well. Keep on as you are."
talk.jaymospowers.judge.weigh_5: "Light. A breath would lift it. A page like this gets a seat here, and a chance to keep its name."
